newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Five China firms to float in 1st half 1997 - agency.
newsitem.headline: Five China firms to float in 1st half 1997 - agency.

text.p: Beijing Municipal Securities Regulatory Commission said five Beijing companies would float their shares in the first half of this year, Beijing-backed China News Service reported on Thursday.
Beijing Pharmaceutical Factory and Wandong Medical Equipment Co would offer A shares, a category of China-listed shares, for domestic investors.
Beijing Dongfang Electronics Gruop and Beijing Chemical Industrial Co would issue B shares, another class of China-listed shares, for overseas investors.
Beichen Group would issue H shares for a Hong Kong listing.
The companies could not be immediately reached for comment.
More than 10 Beijing-based firms would issue shares in stock markets to raise about 4 billion to 5 billion yuan this year, the news agency quoted an unidentified "authoritative source" as saying.
Ten Beijing companies had floated their shares so far, the report said.
